title: Sweden Takes Delivery of Taurus KEPD 350 Cruise Missiles From German Stocks
excerpt: Sweden has taken delivery of Taurus KEPD 350 cruise missiles bought from German military stocks for Gripen integration; the number delivered was not disclosed.
